name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Rowan, Mason, and Riverside belong to different artisans.
Either Rowan goes with Riverside or Mason goes with Bridgegate.
Wulfric does not go with Bridgegate if and only if Carpenter does not go with Wulfric.
